info.title: Adobe Analytics 2.0 API
info.description: Twelve operations of the Adobe Analytics 2.0 API, converted from the vendor's Swagger 2.0 and report-suites OpenAPI documents, which name no scheme, with an oauth2 scheme at the endpoints of Adobe's authorization server. Every path is relative to https://analytics.adobe.io/api/{globalCompanyId}, which the entry gives as base_url; every call also carries x-api-key with the client id, which the entry sends.

path_prefix.because: The entry gives the company in its base_url, https://analytics.adobe.io/api/{global_company_id}, so no operation asks for it

headers_left_out.because: The runtime sends the token in Authorization, and the entry sends x-api-key with the client id of the connection, so neither is a parameter a function gives

lists_as_text: The API reads a list in a query as its values comma-separated, which the runtime sends from a string and not from a list
boolean_values_left_out: The vendor lists 'true' as the one value of some boolean parameters, which no boolean is
